name: Annoter
description: Circle what is wrong on a capture, write a word beside it, and the agent that asked receives the annotated image and your notes.
author: Hangar

gallery.permissionsSummary: Reads an image of the workspace, writes the annotated PNG and a JSON of the notes to .hangar/annotations/, and tells the agent that asked where they are.

path.description: The image to annotate, relative to the workspace folder: .hangar/capture.png. A PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF. Without it the tab waits for the person to paste (Ctrl+V), drop or choose one.
